changes.comment: Fix RegionOps.regionBooleanXY returning undefined or an incomplete result for arcs that are tangent to within tolerance near an endpoint where a coincident overlap starts: report such near-tangent arc-arc intersections at the endpoint, and report both pieces of an arc overlap that spans the start of the other arc when the first arc sweeps backward. Order edges that leave a vertex with the same or almost the same tangent by points along the edges, and skip these adjustments if they leave a region boundary open in the graph. Keep result faces bounded by a single closed curve.
